subject: Recap & timebox offer — trial setup next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <agreen@starlake.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & trial setup next steps

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a suggested path to get your trial live:

- Goal you called out: validate inference latency and cost on a 5k-query/day slice, plus integration with internal QA tooling.
- Ideal timeline you mentioned: try to have something in the upcoming sprint (2–3 weeks) if feasible.
- Blockers we heard: engineering bandwidth (infra reviewers) and a short security checklist from your compliance team.

Next steps we proposed on the call: 
1) I’ll share our trial setup checklist (attached) — items we can pair on vs. you can complete.
2) We’ll provision a short-lived trial API key and a pre-configured test model endpoint.
3) Optional 60-minute bootcamp with Ben from CS to walk through integration and telemetry.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the security checklist and whether we should route evidence to your SOC mailbox or directly to Maya? If you’re still targeting this sprint we can reserve the trial seat for a two-week timebox (details below).

Attached: trial-setup-checklist.pdf

Thanks — I’ll keep Ben in the loop for scheduling the bootcamp if that’s useful.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

From: Alex Green <agreen@starlake.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & trial setup next steps

Thanks, Soojin.

We’ll review the checklist with our infra lead and Maya will coordinate the compliance items. I should have a short update for you early next week — might be a quick yes/no on scheduling the bootcamp.

— Alex
Alex Green
Head of Platform Engineering | Starlake Analytics
agreen@starlake.io

On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 2:15 PM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> (see above)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <agreen@starlake.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Timebox offer to keep trial seat warm (proposal)

Hi Alex — circling back as we haven’t seen activity on the checklist yet. Two quick options to make this low-effort on your side: 

Option A — 2-week timebox (recommended): we hold the trial environment and provide a short onboarding session. If you’re able to run basic integration tests within that window we’ll treat that as active progress; otherwise we’ll close the trial and reopen on request.

Option B — Light hold: we keep the trial API key active but deprioritize dedicated onboarding; you can pick up later without reprovisioning.

Proposed scheduling: 60-minute onboarding/bootcamp with Ben the week of Dec 6 — I have Wed 12/8 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 12/9 1:00–2:00 PT available. If those don’t work, share a couple windows and I’ll adjust.

If you’d prefer, Lauren (cc’d) can approve a short extension on the seat from our side while you sort internal priorities. We’re flexible but want to be transparent about capacity.

If I don’t hear back by Dec 15 I’ll assume you want to pause and will archive the reserved seat; we can always reopen later. If you want us to escalate to a technical workshop, say the word and Ben will lead.

— Soojin

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <agreen@starlake.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood bootcamp: short agenda + scheduling link

Alex — happy to run the bootcamp and get telemetry flowing. Draft agenda attached; topics we’ll cover:
- Quick architecture review (10m)
- Instrumentation & cost telemetry (15m)
- Sample integration walkthrough (20m)
- Q&A and next steps (15m)

Here’s my scheduler if you want to book a slot: https://cal.redwood.com/ben/60min

I can tailor the integration walkthrough to whichever test dataset you want to use. If you’d like, send over a small sample and I’ll prepare a short README for your engineers.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-bootcamp-agenda.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <agreen@starlake.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Final check — timebox expiry and next steps

Alex — quick follow on the previous note. We haven’t received confirmation for the bootcamp or the checklist items, so this is just a last quick check:

- If you want us to hold the 2-week timebox, reply with a one-line "hold" and we’ll schedule the onboarding.
- If you need more time, reply with an approximate re-engage date and we’ll reopen accordingly.
- If you don’t want to move forward right now, reply with "pause" and we’ll archive the seat (no hard feelings).

We prefer a quick one-line so we can keep things tidy on both sides. If I don’t hear back by Mon Dec 20 I’ll archive the trial seat and mark the deal as paused in our tracker (HS-24321).

Thanks for considering Redwood — happy to keep the door open whenever you’re ready.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
